pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal, dark-pigmented regions with sharp-edged gradients. Shapes are predominantly irregular and multi-sided on the central flank, becoming significantly smaller and more clustered toward the hindquarters and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of high-contrast, light-colored negative space. Intersections are primarily tri-radiate. The pathways maintain a consistent thin pixel width across the mid-flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the upper cervical ridge, presenting as a dark, tufted silhouette against the light background.
